title: Critical motor component supplier failure

trace: JOB-4471 Conveyor line retrofit: 60 pcs by 2026-11-06 (critical path)
JOB-4478 Pump skid build: 25 pcs by 2026-11-10
4 suppliers carry an equivalent 7.5 kW B3 motor
Volta: 25 in stock, B35 variant only
KD-7.5-B3 (Kestrel): frame 132S, shaft 38 mm, IE3: compatible
VI-7.5-B35 (Volta): mount differs, adapter needed: unverified
Recommended OPT-A: highest confidence among deadline-feasible options

options.label: Kestrel motors + Ironbridge frames (expedited)
options.reasoning: Kestrel KD-7.5-B3 is a verified drop-in equivalent (same frame size 132S, shaft 38 mm, IE3). Kestrel holds 140 units in its Rotterdam hub; Ironbridge can fabricate 38 frames in 3 days from existing drawings. Arrives 8 days before the JOB-4471 deadline.
sources: Supplier catalog: Kestrel Drives (quote Q-KD-2210, valid to 2026-10-31)
Compatibility agent: datasheet comparison KD-7.5-B3 vs MTR-7.5KW-IE3
Ironbridge capacity confirmation (email 2026-10-24 09:12)

actions.label: Consolidate 8 motors at the JOB-4471 pick face

options.label: Northfield motors + Meridian frames (standard)
options.reasoning: Lowest cost, but Northfield's 16-day lead time misses the JOB-4471 deadline by 3 days. Only viable if the retrofit start can slip.
sources: Supplier catalog: Northfield Electric (quote Q-NF-5531)
Meridian Steelworks price list 2026-Q4

options.label: Split order: Kestrel 40 + Volta 25 motors, Ironbridge frames
options.reasoning: Fastest arrival and reduces single-supplier risk, but Volta units are a different frame variant (B35) requiring adapter plates; compatibility is unverified for 25 units.
sources: Supplier catalog: Volta Industrial Supply (spot quote)
Compatibility agent: B35 vs B3 mount, unverified
